text: Bitcoin trades near $84k after a week that closed about 4% higher. ETF inflows carried the gain while perpetual traders and profit-takers sold into it, and Monday's dip takes price back to the lower end of its range. https://glassno.de/4ACHe7s
Spot traders are turning to altcoins. Total spot volume now runs close to 4x Bitcoin's, the highest since September 2025. Demand for higher risk like this has often lined up with local tops in $BTC.
